spec.data_source: Authenticated exact selected native Pod GET, current timestamped log GET and identity-bound Pod recheck.
spec.predicate: Scans up to 100 returned current-container log lines from the fixed preceding hour for each selected Pod/container, using both offline detectors. Pod identity and restart state must remain coherent; other logs and credential validity are not assessed. Empty, busy-window, wire-debug, unbound or incomplete clean samples remain unresolved.
